ch0224_00_izumi/0101_0701_01_10:
Well, if it isn’t [Name:PlayerNickname ].
We bump into each other a lot, don’t we.
ch0224_00_izumi/0101_0701_02_10:
The way you battle with such hope...
I look forward to seeing it again today.
ch0224_00_izumi/7101_0701_02_10:
There’s an admin meeting coming up.
Where could he be?
ch0224_00_izumi/7102_0701_01_10:
On Pasio, we have a truce with
Team Magma.
ch0224_00_izumi/7102_0701_02_10:
Sometimes, we hold meetings where we
exchange opinions. One of the admins seems
pretty smart...
ch0224_00_izumi/7102_0701_03_10:
but I just don’t like that sort of rigid, logical
personality.
ch0224_00_izumi/7102_0701_04_10:
I prefer how we are in Team Aqua—free
and easygoing.
ch0224_00_izumi/7103_0701_01_10: Do you want to join Team Aqua?
ch0224_00_izumi/7103_0701_02_10:
If you joined, Archie and Matt would
be happy...
ch0224_00_izumi/7103_0701_03_10:
and you could probably help me with some
things, too.
ch0224_00_izumi/7103_0701_04_10: Anyway, let me know if you ever feel like it.
ch0224_00_izumi/7104_0701_02_10:
He thinks about his team members, in his
own clumsy way, and he’s great at
inspiring them.
ch0224_00_izumi/7104_0701_03_10:
That said... His impulsiveness might not be
everyone’s cup of tea.
ch0224_00_izumi/7105_0701_02_10: Do you take good care of your Pokémon?
ch0224_00_izumi/7105_0701_03_10:
I didn’t even need to ask, did I? Don’t ever
change that kind heart of yours.
ch0224_00_izumi/1701_0701_01_10: Oh, perfect. I have something for you.
ch0224_00_izumi/1701_0702_01_10: Just be grateful and take it.
ch0224_00_izumi/2501_0701_01_10:
Team Aqua is full of intense and
stubborn people.
ch0224_00_izumi/2501_0701_02_10:
They’re good people, but they’re hard to
organize.
ch0224_00_izumi/2501_0701_03_10:
I mean, you know how our leader is, so I
guess it can’t be helped.
ch0224_00_izumi/2501_0702_01_10:
If Archie could calm down a little, it would
make things easier for me.
ch0224_00_izumi/2501_0702_02_10:
Actually, could you have a word with
Archie?
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0701_01_10:
Do you know any shops around here that sell
furniture and stuff?
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0701_02_10:
I was just thinking of giving our hideout a
little makeover.
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0701_03_10:
Not many in Team Aqua care about that kind
of thing...
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0701_04_10:
So someone has to take care of it, or the
hideout becomes a disaster.
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0702_01_10:
Hey, do you know any shops that sell
Pokémon dolls?
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0702_02_10: Why? I want to buy a doll, of course!
ch0224_00_izumi/2511_0702_03_10:
If you’re bored, let’s go together.
Lead the way.
ch0224_00_izumi/3001_0701_01_10:
It’s about time I made my rounds. Gotta
wake up all the lazy sleepyheads on
my team...
ch0224_00_izumi/3003_0701_01_10:
I’m taking a day off to go shopping! But as
for where...that’s a secret I’ll never
tell. *chuckle*
ch0224_00_izumi/3005_0701_01_10:
It’s late, so head home, kiddo. If it’s a battle
you want, it can wait till tomorrow.
